subject: 18. Need Designer name field in WFXSOPackage import file format. Company - indochine international

candidates.text: The system shall be enhanced to include a mandatory “Designer Name” field in the WFXSOPackage sample order import file format, ensuring that sample orders cannot be created unless a valid designer name is provided and properly mapped during the import process.

chunks.title: 1. Current Functionality
chunks.heading: 1. Current Functionality
chunks.text: Currently, there is a functionality to import sample orders into the system through EDI using the WFXSOPackage. Users fill in the details in a pre-formatted file, upload the file, and the system automatically creates the sample order based on the provided information.

chunks.title: 2. Functional Requirements
chunks.heading: 2. Functional Requirements
chunks.text: The system shall be enhanced to include a mandatory “Designer Name” field in the WFXSOPackage sample order import file format, ensuring that sample orders cannot be created unless a valid designer name is provided and properly mapped during the import process.
